fields.name: privacy_authorization_id
fields.description: Unique authorization or protected-access decision identifier.

fields.name: customer_account_number
fields.description: Account to which the authorization applies.

fields.name: privacy_cpni_action
fields.description: Use, disclose, permit access, market, revoke, or limit action.

fields.name: privacy_approval_method
fields.description: Written, oral, or electronic approval method.

fields.name: privacy_approval_status
fields.description: Opt-in, opt-out, disapproved, revoked, limited, or permitted-without-approval state.

fields.name: privacy_approval_obtained_at
fields.description: Timestamp when customer approval was obtained.

fields.name: privacy_revocation_at
fields.description: Timestamp when approval was revoked or limited.

fields.name: privacy_authentication_method
fields.description: Approved method used to authenticate the customer.

fields.name: privacy_authentication_result
fields.description: Successful, failed, escalated, or not required outcome.

fields.name: privacy_access_channel
fields.description: Telephone, online, in-store, or approved business-customer channel.

fields.name: privacy_disclosure_recipient_type
fields.description: Customer, affiliate, agent, third party, or legal recipient category.

fields.name: privacy_marketing_campaign_id
fields.description: Campaign identifier when CPNI is used for marketing.

fields.name: privacy_supervisory_approval_status
fields.description: Supervisory-review result for outbound marketing requests.

fields.name: privacy_customer_notification_at
fields.description: Timestamp of an applicable account-change notification.

fields.name: privacy_access_log_reference
fields.description: Reference to the immutable access or disclosure record.

fields.name: privacy_record_retain_until
fields.description: Minimum retention date for the authorization and related audit evidence.

fields.name: privacy_regulation_citations
fields.description: Applicable 47 CFR Part 64 Subpart U citations.
